about: Night bans on renting shared scooters. A night belongs to the evening it starts on: "fri" with 00:00–05:00 is the early hours of Saturday. Bans on the eve of public holidays are left out.
areaSource: Norwegian municipalities from Kartverket (CC BY 4.0), British local authority districts from the ONS (Open Government Licence v3.0), Portuguese municipalities from the CAOP (Informação geográfica cedida pela Direção-Geral do Território, CC BY 4.0), American incorporated places from the Census Bureau's TIGERweb (public domain) and Kyiv, Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa, Turku, Lahti, Porvoo, Montréal's Parc Jean-Drapeau and Michigan State University's campus, cut out of East Lansing, from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL), simplified to within 100 m by scripts/update-curfew-areas.mjs

curfews.note: The rule bans every night but lets the city trial weekday nights, and Voi and Ryde open them. Only Friday and Saturday nights are sure.

The hours Voi, the only operator, enforces: its feed lists no scooters from 23:00 (23:20 on two nights) to 05:00, every night from 16 to 23 October 2026. The regulation, FOR-2025-02-27-363 § 6 c (2) (https://lovdata.no/forskrift/2025-02-27-363), bans renting from 24:00 to 05:00 every day and lets the kommunedirektør tighten that. The city page (https://www.arendal.kommune.no/tjenester/vei-parkering-og-havn/parkering/elsparkesykler/, Begrensninger for bruk, changed 7 July 2026) says renting isn't possible from 23:00 to 06:00.

The four Grenland municipalities set renting hours in their yearly announcement, here for 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027: Porsgrunn closes the whole municipality from 23:00 to 05:00 every night, while Skien stays open and slows scooters to 12 km/h from 00:00 to 05:00. Ryde's Porsgrunn feed opens 05:00–22:59.
Voi's permit covers Straume, on Sotra, which the map names Sotra.

curfews.rule: El-sparkesykler på Askøy: Utleie og bruk, updated 21 August 2026
curfews.note: Askøy has no forskrift on Lovdata; the kommune's page says renting stops on the nights to Saturday and Sunday, from 24:00 to 05:00. A draft forskrift went out for comment in June 2026.

curfews.note: Covers Brighton and Hove. A hire started before midnight runs on until the rider ends it.
West Northamptonshire Council's page, last updated 11 September 2025: Voi's scooters are available from 4am to 11pm daily.

The martial-law curfew bars being in the street and travelling without a pass, so no scooter may be ridden. 3electra’s terms limit renting to keep it. The page keeps its old address, from when the curfew began at 23:00.
Rides may start from 05:00 to 20:45 and must end by 21:00. The rules took effect on 28 April 2026.
Scooters are also off all day when the Huskers play football at home, which a nightly window can't hold.

curfews.rule: Administrative Regulations for Shareable Dockless Mobility Device Permit Holders, § VI(d)(1)(i)
curfews.note: The regulations, linked from ATLDOT's page, set 02:00–04:00 from 13 November 2024, after Council resolution 24-R-4212; scooters stop working from 02:20. The page's own note still gives the hours of 2022, 00:00–04:00.

curfews.rule: City Code § 24-131(3), as amended by Ord. 2023-029
curfews.note: Scooters may run only from 05:00 to 01:00. No later ordinance amends the section. Municode and the city's FAQ still give the hours before 2023, 05:00 to 21:00.
Filed with the Metropolitan Clerk on 16 September 2026. The rule bars riding scooters, not bicycles or e-bikes, from midnight to 05:00.

curfews.rule: Micromobility, UF Transportation and Parking Services
curfews.note: The University of Florida's page on the City's Micromobility Program, read 23 October 2026: "E-scooters are available for rent each day from 6 AM – midnight", in the city and on campus. The rule is City Code § 26-196(e), on municode, which refuses scripts.
The city's page, updated 30 June 2026: "Ordinance requires companies disable scooters at midnight. They're turned back on the following day at 4 a.m."
Scooters may be ridden from 06:00 to 23:00, seven days a week. NC State's campus, inside the city, keeps the same hours.
Shared devices other than bicycles can't be enabled from 23:00 to 06:00. The city may change the hours on 48 hours' notice to operators.

curfews.rule: Department of Transportation & Engineering, Electric Scooters
curfews.note: Bird's and Lime's scooters are "available for rent" from 06:00 to 23:00, seven days a week. The page was read in its Internet Archive copy of 18 May 2026, as the city's site refuses connections from Europe; WCPO reported the end of the day moving back to 23:00 in January 2023.

Licensees must "remove all electric skateboards from the public rights-of-way within the city between the hours of 3:00 a.m. and 6:00 a.m. each day"; Michigan law calls stand-up e-scooters electric skateboards, and the city's Electric Scooters page names Lime as its only approved scooter company. Michigan State's campus is university land under the trustees' ordinances, which set no hours, so it is cut out: Spin's campus fleet and Lime's scooters there stay rentable.

curfews.rule: Scooter Share program report to the Housing, Land Use and Transportation Committee, 8 May 2025
curfews.note: The city staff report charts the program curfew: 22:00 to 06:00 at first, extended to midnight with a 05:00 start, then in 2023 to 02:00 with a 05:00 start. The agreements the city signed with Lime and Spin in June 2025 are not published; Lime’s own map emptied after 02:00 and filled again at 05:00 on 26 October 2026.

curfews.rule: Trottinettes électriques au parc Jean-Drapeau, read on 26 October 2026
curfews.note: The Société du parc Jean-Drapeau, not the City of Montréal, sets the hours: « Les trottinettes électriques peuvent être utilisées entre 6 h et 23 h, tous les jours », and not outside the park. Its pages gave the same hours in 2024 and 2025. Lime is its operator.
